C45251.observed:
Two of the case's three points were checked and both are correct; the third could not be checked at all on this QA branch, so the case is marked Blocked rather than passed on part of it.

WHAT WAS CHECKED AND PASSED - the INVENTORY part. A line was built for this: a new work order line on work order S9315-15899, an inventory part (Slack Adjuster, part number F40010212) added at quantity 5, picked, and the line then set to Complete. Opening that part on the completed line brings up the "Edit Part" window, and in it exactly the right things can be changed: Category, Sell price, Margin and the bin Quantity are editable, while Part number, Description, Vendor, Cost and Core charge are all read-only. That is point 1 and point 3 of the case, both correct.

WHAT STOPPED THE THIRD POINT - the SPECIAL ORDER part. Point 2 needs a special-order part that has been ordered and received. A special-order part was created and ordered successfully (it moved to "Awaiting Receive"), but it cannot be received on this branch: clicking "Receive" on the part opens nothing at all - no window, no panel, no message - and the page records an internal error at that moment. Because the part is never received, the line can never be completed with it, so there is no completed special-order part to open. Ten different ways of receiving it were tried and none worked.

WHAT VIKTORIA NEEDS TO KNOW WHEN RETESTING ON STAGING. First, the note on the case is right that the part must be PICKED and not merely "In stock" before the line will go to Complete. Second, run this case BEFORE the "Add Part stays available on a Complete line" case, or on a different line - that case adds a part to the completed line, and that new part cannot be cleared afterwards, so the line can never be put back into Complete. Third, if "Receive" works on Staging, the special-order half of this case can be finished there.

Separately, the "Receive" button doing nothing is a problem in its own right and has been reported to the QA lead - it is outside this feature, but it stops parts being received.
C45251.todo: Retest this case on Staging once the "Receive" button works.
